MARIA ROOSEN ?
@mariaroosen

Maria Roosen was born in 1957 in Oisterwijk, The Netherlands, and lives and works in Arnhem. Roosen’s art encompasses watercolors, textiles, sculptures and installations. She has gained international recognition for her unique use of blown glass that makes the material appear soft and tactile.

“Because the world is bad enough as it is. Because sometimes things may not be as bad as they seem. Softness can be as meaningful as what is pointed or jagged. Love is a powerful force and as true as aggression and destruction.”
-Maria Roosen 

Maria Roosen calls herself “an artist with green fingers”—fittingly, her sculptures and installations feature imagery that references both plant and human organs, often in conjunction. Though her practice incorporates wool, wood, and sometimes watercolor, Roosen is best known for her ability to manipulate hand-blown glass. Rétromania : plongée dans l'univers ferroviaire parisien des années 80 grâce à notre ami Maarten van der Velden !

Puisque demain c'est férié, nous avons décidé de vous proposer quelque chose d'un peu différent : un petit voyage dans le temps ! L'avantage des années 80, c'est que cette époque est à la fois assez proche de nous... et en même temps très différente. 

Certains matériels étaient déjà là (Sybic), tandis que d'autres étaient déjà sur le déclin. Même certains lieux ont "légèrement" changé : ainsi, la dalle de la gare Montparnasse n'avait pas encore été construite !

Du coup, saurez-vous reconnaître tous les matériels ferroviaires de cette série ? Pour certains c'est (très) facile – surtout pour des spécialistes comme vous ! – mais pour d'autre... c'est peut-être un peu moins évident !

EMANUELA CAMACCI
@manucamacci
Emanuela Camacci was born and grew up in Rome, a city rich in history, art, beauty and many green areas.  A city where the pagan aspect mixes with the Catholic faith like in a Fellini movie. It is a heritage from which it is impossible to escape and which has certainly built my aesthetic and formal canons.

In 2020 the series of works "Urban Nature" was born, where I tried to find a strong and powerful language. I use stone flakes taking pleasure from this suspended time, and giving these remains a new form. It is a new, different and changing nature, where the process of working brings me into a state of reflection, of meditation. From the fragmentation of the rock that creates splinters that seem to become organic, come alive and vibrate between light and shadow, building large compositions. The Consolidated Rail Corporation, or Conrail, was the primary Class I railroad in the Northeastern United States between 1976 and 1999. The trade name Conrail is a portmanteau based on the company's legal name. It continues to do business as an asset management and network services provider in three Shared Assets Areas that were excluded from the division of its operations during its acquisition by CSX Corporation and the Norfolk Southern Railway.

The federal government created Conrail to take over the potentially-profitable lines of multiple bankrupt carriers, including the Penn Central Transportation Company and Erie Lackawanna Railway. After railroad regulations were lifted by the 4R Act and the Staggers Act, Conrail began to turn a profit in the 1980s and was privatized in 1987. •
The HO scale La Mesa Model Railroad Club is located inside the San Diego Model Railroad Museum which is located in Balboa Park, in San Diego, California, USA. 
•
The La Mesa Model Railroad Club’s layout models Bakersfield, California (USA) through the Tehachapi mountains to Mojave, California (USA). 
•
At the La Mesa Club, if you add all the scale miles of the mainline track, railroad yards, spurs, sidings, storage tracks, wyes, helixes, balloon tracks and return loops, there is approximately 90 scale miles of track (or more) on the layout. The mainline track is about 30 scale miles of track!! 
•
It has been said that the La Mesa Model Railroad Club’s layout is the largest model train layout in the world that models a real railr

As mudanças dependem da ação de cada um, o tempo tem relação com o ritmo do outro, com o respeito ao outro.

Quando falamos de bebês e crianças pequenas, estamos cuidando e entendendo que cada sujeito tem seu ritmo de desenvolvimento e amadurecimento.

Mas que depende de nossa ação para permitir isso, ou seja, construir espaços livres para se desenvolver, não interromper, construir laços nos momentos de cuidados.

O tempo muda, mas só muda se nós agirmos antes.

Já pensou nisso?

A día de hoy son muchos los lectores que disfrutan y se emocionan al leer cada una de sus obras. Lecturas cargadas de sabiduría para una vida llena de aventuras que capturo y exteriorizo como pocos son capaces de hacerlo, bella, sutil y armoniosamente.

The New York Central Railroad (reporting mark NYC) was a railroad primarily operating in the Great Lakes and Mid-Atlantic regions of the United States. The railroad primarily connected greater New York and Boston in the east with Chicago and St. Louis in the Midwest, along with the intermediate cities of Albany, Buffalo, Cleveland, Cincinnati, Detroit, Rochester and Syracuse. New York Central was headquartered in New York City's New York Central Building, adjacent to its largest station, Grand Central Terminal.

The railroad was established in 1853, consolidating several existing railroad companies. In 1968, the NYC merged with its former rival, the Pennsylvania Railroad, to form Penn Central. Penn Central went bankrupt in 1970 and merged into Conrail in 1976. Conrail was broken-up in 1999, and portions of its system were transferred to CSX and Norfolk Southern Railway, with CSX acquiring most of the old New York Central trackage.

Estas tres preposiciones confunden mucho porque se usan un poco diferente que en español. La preposición "en" en español puede ser o "in" o "at" u "on" en inglés dependiendo del contexto. Vamos a aclarar las diferencias esenciales entre estas preposiciones.

1?? IN ? adentro
“In” implica que algo o alguien está adentro de algo. Normalmente en un espacio cerrado, por ejemplo, en una caja o en un cuarto, pero también se usa para decir que estamos en ciudades, países, etc. Por ejemplo:

• The toys are in the box.
• My phone is in my pocket.
• The water bottle is in the bag.
• The cat is in the kitchen.
• I’m in Barcelona.
 ??????????
2?? ON ? encima 
Si algo o alguien está encima de otra cosa, por ejemplo, una mesa, el techo de un edificio, etc., usamos la preposición “on”. Por ejemplo:

• The keys are on the table.
• The store is on Victoria Street.
• The picture is on the wall.
• The car is on the road.
• I’m on the roof.

También se usa “on” con medios de transporte

En el decir de Walter Benjamin, “la construcción de la vida está mucho más bajo el dominio de hechos que de convicciones”, y “de una clase de hechos que casi nunca han constituido la base de las convicciones”. Resulta una torpeza no abolirse de convicciones, no migrarse de ellas,  en tanto ellas hijas de los hechos, en tanto hechos son cómo la polarización hegemónica los muestra.

The remedy for burnout is not changing jobs, earning more money, or taking a luxurious vacation somewhere (though that last one would be nice ?). 

The remedy to burnout is wholehearted engagement in self and life! Re-lighting the embers of meaning and purpose in your work and in your life - and regaining your power through perspective shifts that make sense! 

?It would be nice to put the blame of burnout on the organization, the system, the manager, etc; but have you tried that? Likely you have and it doesn’t help. Sometimes it even fans the flames and you come away with more anger and more frustration. ??

?Fighting fire with fire only works if it’s a candle and yoga, a hot bath, or a meditation . . . Just a starting point - And from there we build up! 

????? we have to be the ones who engage in answering the tough questions, for ourselves, and then follow through with what can help. 

Five to Thrive: 
? start with self-love
? apply self-care
? listen to your needs
? seek learning

River's grandma was Margaret Duntz (last 2 slides).

She and her husband Meyer, River’s grandfather, took the Phoenix’s into their home in Florida when they returned to the US, having escaped from The Children of God. They hadn’t seen River since he was a baby and were shocked that at eight years old he had received no formal education, insisting that he be put in school immediately, which he was for a brief period. Two days after River’s death, she was unable to refer to him in the past tense, “I can’t describe what a wonderful kid he is. I can’t understand why – how – it could happen. He’s natural. He watches his weight. He watches what he eats. He doesn’t eat meat. He’s gentle. It’s a mystery”

“She was such an amazingly unique woman; always accentuating the positive even through many of life’s struggles being the daughter of very poor immigrants arriving from Hungary. Deeply affectionate, very funny, wise, quick witted and a great entertainer, her three daughters loved her so much!

32. The Book of Joshua

Author:
Joshua, according to Jewish tradition (except for the ending, possibly written by Phinehas the high priest)

Date Written: 1380 B.C.

Content:
The book of Joshua is about leadership--more specifically, about Joshua's leadership of the Israelites. 

At the opening of the book, Moses had already died, and Joshua had been appointed his successor. While the Israelites waited on the plains of Moab, Joshua prepared them for battle. Once they were ready, Joshua led them across the Jordan River to begin their conquest of the land God had promised them. The Israelites then fought three campaigns: (1) one in the central region, (2) one in the south, and (3) one in the north. After the initial victories, Joshua and his people divided the land among the tribes of Israel. 

As the book comes to an end, Joshua is old and close to death, and he urges the Israelites to follow the LORD their God.

Ref: Holy Bible New Living Translation second edition.

The choice of shadows on the characters' faces is not only beautiful from a purely aesthetic point of view, but also becomes a functional choice for the plot, recalling the "shadow" theme that accompanies the whole episode. Moreover Asuka's gaze in slide 5, the moment her pride is hurt, has something spooky, with her face plunged into shadow but her blue eyes remaining striking clear and sharp.

Matching Your Fragrance To Your Outfit?
Tobacco Vanille.

Brown suede leather, leather boots & black chinos. That’s exactly what I wore today to match my fragrance, Tobacco Vanille.
This fragrance encapsulates the cooler weather that Fall & Winter brings perfectly. A masculine Tobacco infused with spices at the top & warm Vanilla throughout.

Fall style is my favourite. The cold weather allows me to break out my more creative outfits.
The turtlenecks worn with blazers or leather jackets, the pea coats & my long coat, layered with boots & my favourite leather gloves, the cold weather really allows me to dress my best.
My fragrances should match this style.

Dior Homme, Black Orchid, Noir Extreme, Sauvage Elixir…
There are all fragrances I’ll be layering on top of only my best outfits this Fall & Winter?
I’ve got some big plans to showcase these amazing fragrances, & I’ll be surely matching them to different outfits as well! Snow is already l beginning to fall in the mountains around me…

Belgian artist ROA is known for large-scale murals depicting wild or urban animals and birds that are native to the country or region that the paintings appear in. ROA uses the wall as it is: with rusty rebars and cracks in it. 
ROA paints his large murals of animals exclusively in a conservative black, white or gray colour palette and mostly with aerosol spray cans. Characteristic is the detail of the fur or plumage, consisting of an amazing number of fine lines. ROA also regularly depicts bones, muscles or organs. The choice of the animals always depends on the location, just like his way of working them out. He always tries to interact with the wall at his disposal. He does this by adapting the pose of the animals to the shape of the wall and by integrating windows and doors into the work. ROA does not work out a design beforehand. Have you heard of Legiteem8? It's an app where experts authenticate and appraise vintage t-shirts.

If you'd like to authenticate your Nirvana t-shirt, you're just interested in its value and having it certified, just search for "Legiteem8" on your phone's app store - select one of the expert authentication services and be sure to use the authenticator code:

Here is my twenty-second entry of @aureliemaron’s #letteringstylechallenge on the prompt “Outline” for Day 22!

For this next challenge, I decided to do a matching piece to my “Here Comes The Moon” post for Outline. I created a mix of serif letters with flourish elements for the words and created a 3D look surrounding the letters and matched the inside of the letters to the white background to get the outlined look. I added details of stars and sparkles inside of the letters and rays sitting behind the phrase to illuminate the letters.

 Do you prefer sunny or rainy days? For me, it is definitely rainy days as I love the fresh smell it leaves behind and the cozy atmosphere it creates. We are supposed to get some good rain later today which I am looking forward to.

I have been dealing with self doubt recently, and felt a little more encouraged by this quote.  It helps to consider that the greatest artists dealt with self doubt too.  And it can come from so many different part of life that don’t even enter the studio doors.  I try to picture my favorite artists doubting themselves too, and then I press forward knowing that I can’t quit.  The art has to be made!! Send a virtual hug to all of you in this same boat today!!

posts.caption_text:
You are cordially invited to the vernissage of 

Surface Tension at galerie with tsjalling:

Saturday 22 October 2022
16:00 - 18:00 hr

Kostersgang 26-a
Groningen

This is my second solo exhibition at @galeriewithtsjalling. 

Surface Tension shows new drawings I have made over the past year. A series of apparently layered drawings in which images accumulate. New connections are made, but many also remain hidden. A metaphor for the intensity of visual stimuli. It is tempting, but trying to understand what you see becomes increasingly complex.

A publication accompanied the exhibition.

Pictures:
1) Overview Surface Tension @galeriewithtsjalling
2) Surface Tension (Rooms), 39 x 55,5 cm, mixed media on paper, 2022
3) Surface Tension (Grid Spaces), 50 x 63 cm, mixed media on paper, 2022

[Unbezahlte Werbung] 

Ich habe „Die theoretische Unwahrscheinlichkeit von Liebe“ von @alihazelwood rezensiert.

Olive ist ein absolut totaler Biologie-Nerd. Sie ist Wissenschaftlerin aus Leidenschaft und quält sich gerade durch Dantes Höllenkreise – besser bekannt als Promotion. Es gibt nicht viele Menschen, die Olive liebt, aber wenn sie jemanden liebt, dann uneingeschränkt und bedingungslos loyal. Deswegen kommt sie auch auf die Idee spät abends in einem ansonsten verlassenen Flur einen Wildfremden – der sich dummerweise als der von allen gefürchtete Dr. Carlson herausstellt – zu küssen. Der Kuss hat allerdings Konsequenzen und plötzlich befindet sich Olive in einer Fake-Beziehung mit Dr. Carlson – Adam – vor dem alle Angst haben, der ein tyrannischer A… ist und der leider viel zu gut aussieht und zu gut riecht und viel zu gut küsst und zu Olive echt süß ist. Mist.

Wenn man ein Herz für Nerds hat, muss man dieses Buch einfach lieben. Ich habe mich in die Handlung und die Charaktere

[Unbezahlte Werbung] 

Ich habe „Das kleine Cottage in Irland“ von Julie Caplin rezensiert.

Eigentlich ist Hannah alles andere als spontan und abenteuerlustig ist sie schon gar nicht. Sie ist die Verlässliche, die Langweilige, praktisch das Gegenteil ihrer Schwester. Doch ein Mal in ihrem Leben, will Hannah etwas Verrücktes tun, etwas nur für sich. Also hat sie sich zu einem Kochkurs angemeldet – allerdings nicht zu irgendeinem Kochkurs, sondern zu DEM renomiertesten Kochkurs überhaupt, dessen Absolventen Sternerestaurants führen. Aber Hannah macht eben keine halben Sachen und wenn sie schon kochen lernen will, dann von der Besten im besten Kochkurs. Dumm nur, dass sie dort ausgerechnet Conor wiederbegegnet, mit dem sie einen One-Night-Stand in Dublin hatte und der jetzt den Ober-A… raushängen lässt.

Obwohl ich Conor manchmal wirklich gern schütteln und erwürgen wollte, hat mir das Buch sehr gut gefallen. Ich fand es etwas schade, dass er ihre Sorgen bezogen auf Dinge in ihrer Umgebu

Agatha Christie ?

Coucou,

Comme vous le savez, je suis une inconditionnelle des romans d'Agatha Christie. 

Et je peux dire que le roman "La fête du Potiron" (nouveau titre: le crime d'Halloween) est l'un de mes préférés. 
L'intrigue est très bien menée. La psychologie et le caractère des personnages sont parfaitement construits. Ils permettent à Agatha Christie de brouiller les pistes. J'ai beaucoup aimé les personnages de Poirot et de Mrs Oliver. Elle apporte un peu de légèreté dans ce roman autour du meurtre d'un enfant.

Ne passez pas à côté également de son plus célèbre roman "le crime de l'Orient Express"! La construction est magistrale...

Et vous, avez-vous déjà lu Agatha Christie? Et quel est votre roman préféré?

Udviklingen og forandringen af min have de sidste 6 år har været stor.

Jeg fik sat et råhus på grunden i 2015, som jeg med hjælp fra min genbo selv byggede færdigt. På samme tid begyndte jeg at anlægge haven fra bar muddermark.

Det har været en rejse og et eventyr at lave alt selv - og hele tiden få nye ideer. 

Havestilen var en helt anden fra start med høje og vilde cottagebede. Nu er hanen meget mere stram og nutidig i sit udtryk.

Swipe og gå tilbage i tiden. 

The development and change of my garden in the last 6 years has been great.

 I had a house put on the plot in 2015, which I completed myself with the help of my neighbor.  At the same time, I started planting the garden.

 It has been a journey and an adventure to do everything yourself - and constantly get new ideas.

 The garden style was completely different from the start with high and wild cottage beds.  Now the design is much more contemporary.

Hester is a beautifully written novel that focuses on the inspiration for Hester Prynn in Hawthorne’s classic novel The Scarlett Letter.

?The Premise?
It is the 1800s and Isobel immigrates from Scotland to Salem, Massachusetts with her husband Edward. Soon after arriving Edward abruptly leaves Isobel alone and penniless while he joins a departing ship as a medic. Alone and afraid Isobel begins to find ways to survive. She’s incredibly gifted at needlework and begins making money selling her craft. Meanwhile she befriends various characters including a young and brooding Nathaniel Hawthorne. They grow closer as Isobel fears her husband will never return. In the backdrop we see the vicious slave trade, the local xenophobia at both the white immigrants and Black men and women, whether free or not, and we are exposed to the incredible double standards for women of the day.

A few years ago, I found that most of my pieces were bought almost exclusively by art collectors and institutions. Occasionally I’d get asked by friends to make something for a first-year wedding anniversary (ahem—paper) and spending $1K+ wasn't an option for most. And so, Eight Emperors was created to provide a way to offer open-edition pieces at lower price points.

It began as a subscription. I thought a few friends might subscribe and get four mystery pieces sent out each year. Almost immediately we were completely overwhelmed. Keeping track of international shipping, when subscriptions start and stop, and roughly a thousand other details was too much for someone who folds paper for a living. It lasted about a year and a half before we stopped taking new subscribers.

Eight Emperors changed course and became a regular webshop where early collectors who want a small piece of art in their home can find a number of options at an affordable price point.

Sure, you might love a 48" x 48

WHAT IS A SPACE-TIME DISTORTION? ? ?

A space-time distortion is a phenomenon that alters the flow of time, speeding it up or making it run slower. Time dilation is the difference in the measurement of time by two identical and perfectly synchronized clocks that arises when one of these clocks is moving at a speed comparable to the speed of light or when it is subject to a different gravitational field than the other. clock. The phenomenon of time dilation was predicted and theoretically explained by the German physicist Albert Einstein in 1905. 

Time dilation is understood as a lag in the measurement of a time interval between two references whose clocks were previously synchronized. This desynchronization can occur in two different situations. The first one is if one of the references moves with a speed close to the speed of light, that is, about 300 thousand kilometers per second. "Marching down the New Mexico mainline of Southern Pacific comes a big 2-8-8-4, looking "right nice" with the cab behind the boiler, and real coal heaped high on that tall-sided tender back there. She's AC-9 Class , a mighty four-cylinder steam locomotive produced by the Lima Locomotive Works in 1939 for Southern Pacific. She's high, wide and handsome, this one, with her statuesque grandeur, her stance of great power unleashed, her striped cowcatcher pilot, her sky-lining, and swivelling front cylinder deck. First, of twelve such ponderous powerful pachyderms, she is in her own way a thing of graceful beauty." Tucumcari, NM. May 11th, 1940.

In Hausach im Schwarzwald begegnete mir am 13.02.1993 der LHB-Prototyp ABvmz 227.4 , ein klimatisierter 1./2. Klasse Abteilwagen der UIC-Z Familie. Soweit ich mich erinnere, wurde der Wagen in einem Umlauf von Dortmund aus in den Schwarzwald bzw. zum Bodensee eingesetzt. 
Es gab diesen einen 1./2. Klasse-Wagen und einen reinen 2. Klasse-Wagen, die 1972 von LHB gebaut wurden (siehe mein Beitrag von gestern).
Auffälligstes äußerliches Merkmal der beiden  Reisezugwagen waren die gesickten Seitenwände. Die LHB-Prototypen sind die ”Urväter“ der EUROFIMA-Wagen die später von vielen europäischen Bahnverwaltungen beschafft wurden. 

Ursprünglich als 51 80 30-70 001-8 mit der Gattungsbezeichnung ABwümz 227 bezeichnet war der Wagen bei Auslieferung im Juni 1972, in Anlehnung an das damals eingeführte “Popwagen“-Lackierschema, auf Höhe des Fensterbandes in Blutorange (RAL 2002) lackiert. "No one else was around at eight o’clock this winter morning, which wasn’t surprising considering the twenty below zero temperature! Lack of wind made it tolerable for a little while until I couldn’t feel my feet.

There were fourteen inches of recent snow and footprints can be seen going toward the locomotive. But surprisingly, none were seen coming back out, nor were the same tracks used to walk back out. It remains a complete mystery, so I christened the place Spook Junction.

It’s might peculiar about the footprints through the snow simply disappear into thin air without explanation, so these Metro North locomotives might be haunted! If you think a haunted train is rather suspicious too, better call Shaggy and Scoob to investigate."

Location: Cooperstown Junction, Ostego County, New York. Picture and story © Andrew Dierks

This old red, white, and blue Metro North train engine has been staying just one step ahead of the scrapyard torch parked here in rural New York, sitting beside a flat-roofed house of even older vintage. There are two of these EMD FL-9 diesel locomotives here, hooked together elephant style nose to tail, and they date from the late 1950s. Both locomotives are missing their number boards which are probably in some collector’s house by now. Usually, if you see a train engine without numbers it’s sitting on the scrap line or headed that way.

These two diesel train engines are part of a railroad museum whose forward progress is best described as glacial.

The HO scale La Mesa Model Railroad Club is located inside the San Diego Model Railroad Museum which is located in Balboa Park, in San Diego, California, USA. 
•
The La Mesa Model Railroad Club’s layout models Bakersfield, California (USA) through the Tehachapi mountains to Mojave, California (USA). 
•
At the La Mesa Club, if you add all the scale miles of the mainline track, railroad yards, spurs, sidings, storage tracks, wyes, helixes, balloon tracks and return loops, there is approximately 90 scale miles of track (or more) on the layout. The mainline track is about 30 scale miles of track!!

posts.caption_text:
Like the humble nasturtiums that got me through a strange summer, I’m going all in with pansies for fall, winter, and spring. 

Planted now in my Pacific Northwest garden, they send down roots and hold their own over the coming, sometimes frozen, months only to explode with blossoms in spring. It’s anticipatory magic, not unlike digging in crocus, tulips, daffodils, and hyacinths, more often than not, plantings marked by a topdressing of pansies.

Pansy comes from the French word “pensee” - which means a thought or a reflection. Not a bad way to spend a cold, dark, season.

Read below for Mnemonics & notes for Thalamus & Hypothalamus ?? @rev.med

If you’re loving this post… just wait till you see what we have coming at you! Right now just follow ?? @rev.med

? Overview

Thalamus are 2 large egg-shaped gray matter. Its nerve fibers extend out in all directions towards the cerebral cortex. Known as the relay station for sensory & motor info passed onto areas of cerebral cortex, basal ganglia, hypothalamus, and brain stem. @rev.med

? Location

*Anterior Thalamus: posterior boundary of
Interventricular foramen.
*Posterior Thalamus: Pulvinar, hanging over
the Superior Colliculus.
*Inferior Thalamus: becomes Tegmentum
(midbrain).
*Medial Thalamus: part of lateral wall of third
ventricle, connected to other Thalamus by
Mass intermedia. @rev.med

? 5 Nuclear Groups

1. Anterior group - anterior nucleus
2. Medial group - mediodorsal nucleus
3. Lateral group - lateral dorsal, lateral
posterior, pulvinar
4. Ventral group - ventral anterior/ ventral
lateral, ventral

Utagawa Kunisada (#ToyokuniIII, 1786-1865)?
Mirror of Famous Ukiyo-e Artists: Picture by Okamura Masanobu, ?
ca. 1825?
?
A teenaged girl seated before a #kyodai (vanity) stares into the mirror while concentrating at applying her eyebrow #makeup. Her kimono is decorated with a wax-resist pattern of horse and cherry blossoms on a purple ground, contrasting with white bamboo leaves on a pink ground, and her light blue inner #kimono has a geometric #uroko (fish scale) motif. ?
?
In the foreground there is a packet of Bien Senjoko face powder, whose owner, Mr. Sakamoto, frequently arranged such product placements in woodblock prints featuring #bijin or #kabuki actors. The cosmetic powder was named after Senjo, the poetry name of the actor Segawa Kikunojo III (1751-1810), a kabuki actor revered for his portrayals of female roles.?
?

“Heavy” is a relative term. Your aim should be to get stronger over time (especially if you’re #natty), but that is relative to how strong you are now. Whether or not you consider something “heavy” should therefore be relevant to you, not anyone else. 

Ronnie’s “heavy” squats weren’t actually “heavy” to him. He mostly trained in the 8-12 rep range if you pay attention to his training. Your goal should be to lift what you can, in a controlled manner, with technique that’s consistent across every single session, set and rep that you do. If you deviate from this controlled technique, you did not get stronger, you just started doing a different exercise. 

Aim to make your sessions as hard as possible and to get stronger relative to those hard sessions over time. Lifting an arbitrary amount of weight that you want to isn’t doing anything for you other than pumping the $hit out of your ego.

Today I’ve got a special diatom for you! 
This one is a beautiful Trinacria, I assume it is Trinacria excavata. ?
The genus Trinacria is another one of my absolute favourites for their special triskelion shape. When manipulating these diatoms it’s not easy to mount them on their delicate “legs”. Also it is quite rare (at least in the material I git so far) to find whole unbroken specimen. 
So it’s definitely something I enjoy finding on the treasure hunt for diatoms for my arrangements. :)
What do you think this one??

posts.caption_text:
Today I had a chance to set the railing and to make sure it all works!
1. I'm glad I can count on Brian and Garza to help me with some additional hands for something like that!
2. The top mounting plate is recessed into the sheetrock and will be mudded in, so no fastening is showing in these spots.
3. Dropped the rails off at the powder coating place, and hopefully can get them back within the next 10 days.
4. All fasters ready for some painting.
5. Painted to match the flat black textured powder coating color.
6. Using some epoxy for testing in regards to the steel balls for the dining table base.
7. I decided to use epoxy to eliminate discoloration caused by welding.
8. A closeup! Now I just wait for 48 hours to let it cure properly

All in a days work!

Artists: Matthew Grote in collaboration with Max Collins and Chuck Tingley.

O artista brasileiro Eduardo Kobra @kobrastreetart inaugurou um painel na entrada do prédio das Nações Unidas, em Nova York, nos Estados Unidos. São 336 metros quadrados de cores verde e amarela, símbolos do Brasil, em um mural que mostra um pai e um filho segurando o planeta Terra, localizado ao centro, cheio de árvores. 

“Para mim os muros são portais onde eu gosto de passar mensagens. O principal objetivo é utilizar murais pra conscientizar sobre temas que eu me envolvo, e acredito”. 

Nunca antes um artista brasileiro teve autorização para pintar este pedaço da fachada da ONU - que tem cerca de 400 metros quadrados. 

“A ideia é mostrar a responsabilidade que nós temos, o que estamos fazendo com o planeta e como vamos entregar ele para as próximas gerações”, afirmou o artista. 

Kobra disse que é possível e necessário ter esperança. Ele explicou que fez questão de colocar a Amazônia brasileira no centro quadro, pois acredita que a floresta tem que ser um dos focos de preocupação m

A small design startup spun off of a mega design firm and eventually pulled them down from their monopoly in 16th century Japan. 

The Kan? school of art had been the go-to design firm for authority since the 15th century and they drew powerful, astounding gold paintings on architectural surfaces to help their clients display their power. The fourth leader KAN? Eitoku was born into such an elitist famliy and learned from his father in Kyoto. 

Also learning under the Kan? school was HASEGAWA T?haku. He was born into a low-class samurai and was adopted to a family running a dye house. He learned to paint from various professionals there and his talent was clear to anyone's eyes.

He moved to Kyoto to learn at the  Kan? school at 33. T?haku appreciated the technical skills he learned there but he couldn't resist pursuing a different artistic style that sparked joy in him. He was determined to make it big on his own and quit.

?? Drawing basic - Line weight ! [FR en SWIPE ??]

?? // Hello there! ?
During yesterdays live you voted for today's drawing tip, si here it is: line weight and line quality ?
Mastering your drawing is an essential skill for a good reading of your drawing! It's actually about emphasizing some features and leaving others lighter, but don't do that randomly; the weight of your line must be used to understand the shapes/volumes of your drawing. ??

You can work on different renderings to get a consistent result:
1 - Thicken your line where there is shadow to give more weight to your volumes
2 - Thicken the outlines of a shape or a shapes group to make it stand out
3 - Give the viewer the feeling of depth through close (thicker) and distant (thinner) objects

I hope these few tips may helped you, let me know in the comments of your advice or your questions if you have any!

Name: Under the Hand

Andreas von Chrzanowski, aka CASE aka CASE Maclaim is considered a pioneer of photorealistic street art. Hands are a recurring theme in CASE's work. 

Carried by the precision of the line and the harmony of the details - usual for this pioneer of the photo-realistic movement, "the gesture tells more than a thousand words"... The two superimposed hands, the fingers which cross and the contrasting skin colors deliver a strong message of unity at the same time as they imprint energy and dynamism. The physical movement of the body as a symbol of the “political” movement, of affirmation, of claim!

"Power" and "movement" played key roles in the backbone of his German roots, inspiring him to convey his powerful messages of unity and power through overlapping hands. [LE POISSON ROUGE] “Plutôt team requin ou team poisson rouge ?”, “Doit-on se transformer en requin, ou reste-t-on tous des poissons rouges ?” La question fait débat chez ceux qui s’attardent devant cette nouvelle œuvre de street-art, apparue il y a quelques jours, rue des Pyrénées, au niveau de @aux_ours_restaurant. Un dessin de la street-artiste @msbejannin, accompagné de la légende : "Jusqu'où ailerons-nous dans un monde de requins ?". 

“J’aime quand le street-art enclenche des réflexions et des discussions”, explique l’artiste qui réside dans le 18e arrondissement de Paris. Illustratrice, graphiste et  rédactrice conceptrice de profession, MS Béja (son nom d’artiste) a pris un virage artistique, en se mettant au street-art il y a un peu plus d’un an. Sa marque de fabrique, “ce sont les animaux, la défense de la nature, et de faire passer - avec humour - un message sur le monde dans lequel on vit”.

Dovolte ješt? pár slov k výluce, konkrétn? k informovanosti cestujících. Denn? procházím kolem zastávek, kde díky výluce nic nejezdí. A denn? tam stojí n?kolik lidí ?ekajících na sv?j spoj. Na t?chto zastávkách totiž visí jediný papír o velikosti A4, který je plný všech možných informací, které vás v tu chvíli moc nezajímají. A zmínka o tom, že zde nic nejezdí, není ani - na rozdíl od autobusové linky 17 - zvýrazn?na. Této cedule si všimne jen ten, který jde vyložen? ke sloupku se podívat do jízdního ?ádu, jinak nikdo. Ob?as je tam ješt? jeden papír s mapkou linek, ovšem zastávky, kde nov? nic nejezdí, tam rad?ji v?bec nejsou zanesené. 

No prost? na t?ch vy?azených zastávkách chybí velká ?ervená cedule "SEM NIC NEP?IJEDE, VYKAŠLALI JSME SE NA VÁS". A pod to už klidn? drobným písmem "Sice jste si zaplatili m?sí?ní, ?tvrtletní nebo ro?ní kupon za fakt nemalé peníze, ale cho?te prost? p?šky!". Když za t?mi lidmi dojdu a ?eknu jim, jak se v?ci mají, net?eba asi popisovat jejich reakce.

- INKTOBER Jour 7 -

Je suis heureuse de vous présenter ce petit éléphanteau pour le thème "bébé animal" du #kidstober ! Je me suis inspirée de différentes illustrations trouvées sur Pinterest, en me faisant la réflexion qu'il était difficile de retrouver les auteurs pour les mentionner. J'en appelais donc hier en story à vos conseils concernant ce réseau social que j'utilise énormément mais que je maîtrise mal. Mais visiblement, on est nombreux dans ce cas et je n'ai pas encore trouvé LE ou LA spécialiste pour me conseiller ! Si jamais vous l'utilisez régulièrement en tant que créateur je serais vraiment curieuse de discuter avec vous ?

Sur ce, je vous souhaite un bon vendredi ! (Je ne sais pas s'il y aura des illustrations ce week-end car je n'ai plus d'avance ?).

This is the second volume of the DECADES book trilogy (vol. 1 1990-2000 / vol. 3 2010-2020) presenting 30 years of graffiti in Berlin. It was a small and insignificant street that you can only pass through on foot or by bicycle, but this cozy alley that connects the Dijkstraat with Rentenierstraat can now no longer be missed. Colin's mural is part of the Street Art Project "Geef Lichtenvoorde Kleur" (Give Colour to Lichtenvoorde) that wants to make the center more attractive for residents and tourists. In this context the artist made a colorful design with flowers, birds and fruits that adorns the facade of the house on the corner with Rentenierstraat. 

Collin van der Sluijs is an international mural artist obsessed with still lifes by great masters.
Growing up in the Dutch province of Zeeland, Collin van der Sluijs was fascinated by his grandpa drawing portraits of the birds in his aviary. During his studies, years later, he started to combine his background in graffiti

posts.caption_text: Being readied for the road is Norfolk & Western K3 class "Mountain" number 204. The ponderous 4-8-2 was built in the railroad's Roanoke Shops, construction number 239, in September of 1926. The railroad seems to have uncharacteristically missed the mark on the design of these locomotives, and the smaller driver diameter and third-set main driver led to counterbalancing issues that caused havoc when they got over 35 miles per hour. The entire class was sold off between 1944 and 1945, number 204 going to the Richmond, Fredericksburg & Potomac where she became the number 519. In 1948 she and her sisters were sold again, ending up on the Wheeling & Lake Erie in the J-1 class. However, that wild change of ownership was still several years away for the 204 when she was photographed next to the roundhouse in Columbus, Ohio in 1937. The locomotive behind her appears to be Z1a class 2-6-6-2 "Mallet" articulated number 1416. #norfolkandwestern #norfolkandwesternrailway #norfolkwestern #roanokesh

Sonntags ist Betriebsruhe!
Und was passt da besser, als das Eisenbahnfest in Thüringen.
Dort stand am 12.06.2021 eine schöner "Elektrocontainer“ in Form von 250 250. Sozusagen die "Schönheit des Hässlichen“. Aber fotografiert hat man sie ja trotzdem und heute freue ich mich über jedes einzelne Bild von der Maschine. Eins muss man der Reichsbahn ja lassen, da war sie der Bundesbahn schon einen Schritt voraus, als sie diese Lokomotiven sogar mit Waschtisch ausgestattet haben. Da hat sich wirklich einer mal Gedanken gemacht… Schade ist nur, das die Baureihe nach ihrer aktiven Zeit im DB Konzern, still und heimlich ausgemustert wurde ??

.

I think i will need to replace it with a new one from bricklink?. That is why i couldn’t share a video to show how it works?. Its headlights are normally works also, which is a great detail i loved now and then??. I will post a separate video after I buy a working motor, promise?. Hope you enjoy the photos??. ?? A golf ball diver usually earns from $50,000 to $100,000 a year.?
?
The independent diver or the company they represent usually signs an exclusive contract with 10-20 courses to retrieve their water hazard balls. Working with this amount of golf courses means that schedules must be very carefully organized so that they can all be covered in the most efficient fashion. They will either pay the golf course a fee for each ball that they recover or offer a percentage of the balls they find. The remaining balls will be either sold to sports stores or sold online.?
?
The golf ball to watch out for is the Titleist Pro V1, the "Cadillac" of golf balls which sells for around $2 each; usually, the golf ball diver will get around 8-10 cents per ball once they have paid the course.?
This involves a fair amount of work for what seems a bit of a measly sum, but remember, when collecting over 3000 balls a day this swiftly adds up to a very decent annual income.?
?
_____?

COOL COOLER COOLNEST

Die letzten Tage konnte ich im @coolnest.at | *Werbung | in Ramsau im Zillertal genießen.  Und ich bin wirklich begeistert - vom Design, vom Ausblick, von den Zimmern, vom Personal, vom Essen … und ich könnte noch weitermachen ?. Hier stimmt einfach alles. 

Das COOLNEST wurde mit viel Liebe zum Detail eingerichtet und Designliebhaber kommen hier voll auf ihre Kosten ?. Trotzdem ist es gemütlich, urig und man fühlt sich rundum wohl und heimelig. 

Highlight ist natürlich der Rooftop Pool mit Bergblick. Ich könnte noch weiter schwärmen, aber am besten ihr schaut in meine Story Highlights oder noch besser ihr überzeugt Euch selbst. 
Das COOLE ist - es gibt einen 10% RABATT CODE „cloodi“, der bis zum 31.10.22 gültig ist (Der Buchungscode ist nicht kombinierbar mit anderen Angeboten und Ermässigungen).

Die nächsten Tage gibts noch mehr Bilder von der coolen MTB Tour nach Klein Tibet ..:).. MUSS man gesehen haben. Wer war schon mal dort? 

Ich war definitiv nicht das

He is Myself: The Art of Nyaparu (William) Gardiner
Spinifex Hill Project Space @spinifexhillartists
14 July - 10 September 

A proud Nyangumarta/Warnman/Manjilyjarra man, Mr. Gardiner was a stockman, award-winning artist, storyteller and language worker whose artwork tells the important story of a time and place cemented in Western Australia’s history. Born in the years leading up to Australia’s first Aboriginal workers’ strike, the 1946 - 1949 Pilbara Strike, Mr. Gardiner lived, worked and raised a family in the country’s remote north-west spanning both the Kimberley and Pilbara. As a member of the renowned ‘Strelley Mob’, his creative body of work is a fascinating insight into the life of Aboriginal pastoral workers and an era of unprecedented social and economic change that included the fight for Aboriginal people’s rights and recognition.

The #TeslaModel3 is not Europe's top-selling electric car anymore. This year it has been dethroned by the #TeslaModelY, as it already happened in USA and China. As a part of the Model 3 imports come from China, it was affected by the lockdown and the stop of production over there. 

The #Fiat500 came third, and closer to the second position than to the fourth position, occupied by another Stellantis car, the #Peugeote208. In the case of the Fiat, the electric version represented 38% of the model's total registrations in H1, vs 21% for the Peugeot. The French B-Hatch increased the gap with the #RenaultZoe, its closest rival. 

The #DaciaSpring hits the top 10 sending the #VWID3 out. The German hatch posted a 44% decline vs H1 2021, when it was the second most popular. Other big drops include the #VolkswageneUp (-56%), #NissanLeaf (-21%), #Smartfortwo (-35%), and #MercedesEQC (-29%).

Were you fooled...?

Think back for a moment.

What happened when Dior announced Sauvage Elixir?

The annoucement was panned.

Predictions rolled in thick and fast.

"Just another Sauvage" complained some.

"Boring Sauvage DNA with a twist" whined others.

New designer flankers are a dime a dozen. 

We know this.

Only a few reach the rarified air worthy of purchase.

Most are just nuanced versions of prior releases.

This one will be no different.

Right?

We were ALL WRONG.

This is NOT just 'another Sauvage'.

Elixir is an intruiging departure from the ENTIRE Sauvage line.

A warm spicy concoction accompanied by grapefruit, lavender, and licorice.

A fragrance with modern mass-appeal that acknowledges masculine fougeres of old.

The release of Elixir has reminded us of a powerful lesson.

Preemptive judgement can be a treacherous Mistress.

Let's speak again soon.

May 27.  This is the first time it’s been Dad’s birthday since he passed away.  A little more than three months ago, but it seems much longer.  I still see him vividly in my mind’s eye and hear the sound of his voice clearly in my thoughts every day. Mostly it’s happy thoughts of a life well lived, and times spent together, sometimes I’m just sad that he’s gone.
A few of those thoughts are strangely connected to this @banksy in #gorleston which appeared as part of the #spraycation last summer.  He liked that kind of thing, so I took him to see it. This was the last photo of the two of us together.  On the day Dad died, I went for a walk in Gorleston with Mum and we happened to sit in that same spot for a while.  On the day after Dad’s funeral, I took part in #gorlestonparkrun which Dad had watched me run previously.  The third picture is with my sister immediately afterwards, at the spot where they scan the #parkrun barcodes.
Miss you Dad xx??

Para os cientistas, o cérebro dos mais velhos funciona como um HD que, repleto de dados, demora mais tempo para acessar as informações. Ou seja, uma possível lentidão em um diálogo, não necessariamente está associada a um declínio do processo cognitivo. 

Quer um exemplo? Se pessoas com 40...50 anos tem dificuldade de concentração ou breves esquecimentos, imagine como é o comportamento de um cérebro de uma pessoa com 80... 90 anos.

O ponto inicial no convívio com idosos que necessitam de ajuda para atividades básicas, como alimentação, higiene, consultas, é o amor e a paciência. 

Cada idoso terá a sua personalidade e a teimosia de alguns, muitas vezes pode estar relacionada a sinais de carência, necessidade de chamar atenção, de se sentirem importantes aos familiares e até mesmo ao medo, por terem a consciência de que estão no ciclo final da vida. 

Mas afinal, o que eu posso fazer?

-Durante o dia, estimule-o a conversar, lembrar histórias do passado e falar sobre temas da atualidad

Vi har låtit syrenen växa ut över bordet så det känns som ett syrentak när vi sitter där. Och doften, den är berusande ljuvlig. På bordet står fyra olika sorters pelargoner som jag köpte hos @slottstradgarden_ulriksdal Wow vilket ställe, fick så mycket inspiration och önskade att vi just då hade haft en större bil. Idag ska jag få ner de sista sexton dahliorna i jorden och plantera om pelargoner. Visst är det en underbar tid vi har just nu? Godmorgon vänner.

Something to galvanize, then something to ground. So, here’s something to ground:

Although Ukrainian settlers, like all white settlers arriving to the prairies, played a role in colonization, I would be doing a disservice if I didn’t also share the histories of inter-community learning and sharing. I also recognize that Ukrainian settlers certainly have a history here in the prairies and that their communities here can be understood as a well-established diaspora.

So, as a grandchild of Treaty 4 and 6 Crees, my heart goes out to Ukrainian settlers here on the prairies many of whom are undoubtedly feeling shock and terror right now. ????

This weekend was.... hectic. Robotics competition, Nephew's birthday, met up with some awesome people for my first game of MESBG. Boromir, Captain of the White Tower is an absolute monster. 

Anyway, I did get some painting done this weekend, mainly Friday night and this afternoon. Also got a chance to fiddle with the 3d printers, and I've been printing my Fiefdoms force. Progress on the Gondor at War scenario book is happening a lot faster than I expected it. I did a test paintjob on the first Axeman of Lossarnach, along with a handful of Warriors of Minas Tirith. 

I've decided to stop trying to do cobbles by hand on the bases, and just resin print bases- as I was dreading doing Minas Tirith models for that reason. Some of the models I did this weekend have resin bases. The ones from Friday have the old style bases.

(English below)

Ja. Der Mühlteurm wird neu bemalt. 
Rund 1000 Churer Schüler haben ihre eigenen Miniatur Muhletürme gestaltet und bei uns eingereicht. Zusammen mit der Stadt hatten wir die schwierige Aufgabe einen Gewinnerturm zu küren. Das Bild einer Schülerin aus der 2. Primarklasse wurde ausgewählt und wird nun von mir und meinem Künstler-Kollegen @rips1 Linus 1 zu 1 auf den Turm übertragen. Das neue Sujet gibt es bald zu sehen. 

The mill tower is repainted.
Around 1000 school kids from Chur designed their own miniature towers and submitted them to us. Together with the city, we had the difficult task of choosing a winning tower. The picture of a kid from the 2nd primary school was chosen and will now be transferred by me and my artist colleague Linus 1 to 1 on the tower. Stay tuned!

Taint, 123x123cms, Oil on panel, 2001-21.

This painting was originally made back in 2001 by sticking down over a thousand of the same small metal sewing machine parts I found in a factory that I’d just moved into. 
For six months I sprayed the metal with water and let the rust run down the panel and make the painting. 
20 years later I revisited it and scraped off all the metal parts and then placed the painting underneath various small paintings and let the falling paint finish the painting(for now).

I love doing master copies of works I admire.  I learn so much from them!  This week, I'm learning from Monet.  I actually got to see this painting (Woman with a Parasol Turned to the Left, by Claude Monet, 1886) when I went to the Musee d'Orsay in Paris.  It's amazing how close you can get to the paintings.  I stood there, just a couple of feet away from this very painting, and thought, "It's just paint." That may seem like a stupid thing to think about when looking at such a great piece of art, but when you study paintings in books, you can't quite appreciate the texture and brushstrokes.  Seeing them in person, up close, removes a bit of the mystery.  It's just paint.  The same thing I have sitting on my palette.  That thought was an encouragement to me.  I won't be Monet, but I have paint and I can use it to create beautiful things and, even though he is long gone, I can sit under him as a student. ?????????
Photo is of my underpainting, 9 x 12, oil on linen board.  #monet #monetst

Had a meeting late one night back in 2011 at a tiny workshop in the middle of nowhere. It was at the side of some guys house.

During the meeting, the tech was showing us a photo album(in a book, with actual photos ?) of work they did on their S2000 and as I looked through, close to the end I was like, “eh, I know this car!” 

My boss was like, “no you don’t..”

“I fucking do, I play Gran Turismo!”

The tech looked surprised that an Irish guy knew the car, then he asks me,
“You want to see it?”

He walks me to the corner of the workshop and pulled the cover off the S2000! I couldn’t believe my eyes! Any old Gran Turismo fans will understand how I felt seeing the actual car in person. 

Huge shoutout to @operaperformance, you guys were so awesome that night and I really enjoyed our meeting. 

*note how terrible the photo quality was in 2011 ??
